topics.title: Leary and Liddy Debate Eastern Europe
topics.summary: Timothy Leary and G Gordon Liddy engage in an unproductive debate regarding the changing geopolitical landscape of Eastern Europe following communism's collapse, with differing opinions on its significance and potential future trajectory. They primarily focus on questioning each other’s perspectives rather than offering substantive analysis or predictions.

topics.title: Joe Walsh's Unconventional Presidential Proposals
topics.summary: During an impromptu conversation, Joe Walsh proposes increasingly unusual actions if he were president, including nationalizing Mexico to house terrorists and lobbing rockets into Panama. He discusses Neil Young’s involvement in a recording situation with Rick the bass player and Steve Jordan before concluding that stealing Mexico from Palestinians would be the most effective solution.
